# BrightAI — Saudi AI governance and safety
> BrightAI is a Saudi platform for operational AI governance and safety. It describes implementation approaches; it is not legal advice, a certification body, or a claim of regulator approval.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-24

## Canonical high-value pages

- [AI Governance Hub](https://brightai.live/hub/ai-governance/): Saudi-enterprise governance owner; roles, risk, controls, evidence, and official-source context.
- [SDAIA AI Risk Guide](https://brightai.live/hub/sdaia-ai-risk-management/): Explains the national AI risk-management framework and separates the official reference from BrightAI operating guidance.
- [Agentic AI Security](https://brightai.live/hub/agentic-ai-security/): Security boundaries for agent identity, tool permissions, data, prompt safety, monitoring, and incident evidence.
- [Agentic AI Governance](https://brightai.live/hub/agentic-ai-governance/): Ownership, approvals, lifecycle, and evidence for AI agents.
- [AI Governance Platform](https://brightai.live/solutions/ai-governance-platform/): BrightAI product page for connecting policy, risk, control, enforcement, and evidence.
- [AI Firewall](https://brightai.live/solutions/ai-firewall/): BrightAI product page for policy checks on configured AI interactions; it does not guarantee prevention or compliance.
- [PDPL and AI Guide](https://brightai.live/docs/pdpl-ai-complete-guide/): Saudi data-protection guide with an official-source panel and implementation boundary.
- [NCA Cybersecurity Guide](https://brightai.live/blog/nca-cybersecurity-requirements-saudi/): NCA cybersecurity context for AI systems; consult the official controls for applicability.
- [ISO/IEC 42001 Guide](https://brightai.live/blog/iso-42001-saudi-implementation-guide/): AIMS implementation guide with ISO as the primary source.
- [Banking AI Governance — Riyadh](https://brightai.live/solutions/banking-ai-governance/riyadh/): Saudi banking context, including SAMA reference and human-review/evidence patterns.
- [AI Governance Readiness Assessment](https://brightai.live/assessment/ai-governance-readiness/): Browser-local, indicative eight-dimension diagnostic; not a regulatory finding or certification.

## Entity and access
